تمتعضوا (form VIII)
# تَمْتَعِضُوا (tamtaʕiḍū) /tam.ta.ʕi.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# تُمْتَعَضُوا (tumtaʕaḍū) /tum.ta.ʕa.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
